\begin{example} \end{example}[Cayley complexes of small groups] ↗ def:cayley-graph-and-complex 1. ch1:1.45\group Covering Spaces

For $G=\Z *\Z $, the Cayley complex is the Cayley graph, the universal cover of $S^1\vee S^1$. \end{example}
